assets.notes: Canonical shape is FRONT: square/rect cloth on a short crossarm, bronze spear finial. Side plates are silhouette only. Cloth texture: vermillion #C23B2E, gold meander border, cream seal 壹. Same mesh as blue, swap albedo.
Same geometry as flag-red. Cloth #3E5F75, cream seal 零.
Horizontal barrel, vermillion shell, bronze tacks, cowhide heads. Sits on the drum tower deck. No people.
Two sticks for the drummer. Drummer mesh reuses the Qin soldier, do not sculpt a new person.
Rammed-earth podium + south stairs + four lantern posts. Empty of people and of the drum (drum is a separate asset). Scene position [25,0,16].
Rammed-earth observation deck, four posts, simple pyramidal wooden canopy, low desk. Qin Shi Huang and von Neumann stand here as separate hero meshes. Scene position [25,0,-17].
Rectangular ridge tent, hemp canvas, guy ropes. Not a yurt or teepee. Distant silhouettes, 4–5 copies.
Daytime unlit: wood shaft + bronze basin, no flame. 12 copies around the yard.
Model a blank dark wood plaque + post. Vertical gold text is painted at runtime (輸入區 / 加法陣 / …). Do not bake one label into the mesh.
秦始皇，监军台上的英雄静模，不实例化。玄衣纁里、通天冠、双手持圭。正面图有龙纹可简化；侧面黑袍更接近秦制。面朝 +Z，脚底贴地。
冯·诺依曼，1940 年代西装，与始皇同台进言（小说 VR 局）。单独静模，不穿秦服。面朝 +Z。运行时加载 vonneumann-proto.glb（无 UV/贴图，灰陶着色）。
夯土地面。运行时用 tile 作 repeat albedo；close 看材质；yard 看操场尺度。
白昼天穹。运行时用 panorama 做天空球（地平线在图底）；horizon / zenith 供对照。
关中侧柏。运行时抠透明后做圆柱公告板，场边自动散布，不种进方阵。
枯草丛。运行时抠透明后做圆柱公告板，只散布在操场边缘，不要铺成草坪。
麻雀展翅静模，少量实例飞过。翅膀姿态烘进网格即可，不必骨骼。
单朵积云体积块，做广告牌或低模体积，挂在天穹里。不要整片天空球。
